findings.finding: Reviewed complete diff from the development runner: no scientific solver, pulse, derivative, noise, observation or reference-decoder changes.
Exactly original reserved phase indices8..39 are used; eight development phases excluded. Global phase identities and32-element context census are tested.
All reference definitions are sealed before any finite outcome. No held-out finite-difference tuning. Every finite history still has a cross-method numerical comparison.
Fixed20000 phase-bootstrap draws preserve paired phases, negative scores and declared denominators. Missing, duplicate or unqualified cells block primary inference.
The interval is conditional on two fixed networks and chosen known-phase measurement protocol. Nonprimary intervals are descriptive; no shrimp-specific or trained-network inference.
Measured development throughput supports the same four-worker local CPU plan; exact private push and shared resource recheck precede target execution.

reviewer: local executing agent; independent mathematical controls and a reviewed diff from the development lifecycle; not independent scientific replication
